subject: Clarify: micro-floor interaction with long-context bundle and proration
messages:
From: Sahil Mehta <sahil@atlasretail.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwoodai.com
Date: Fri, 28 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Question on bundle pricing + minimums for long-context use

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for the demo last week — the latency profile looked great. Before we proceed with procurement I need a clear example from you on how the proposed 50k token bundle interacts with the micro-flooring rule you mentioned on our call. Two specific asks: 

1) If a single user session consumes 12k tokens (prompt + completions) and we have micro-burst heartbeats that add 2k tokens intermittently over the day, do we charge per-session or does the bundle amortize across sessions?

2) If several sessions reuse KV cache and you suggest prefix reuse credits, how are those credits applied when we’re on a bundled committed SKU vs pay-as-you-go?

We’ll attach a short SOW and invoice template (procurement requested examples) — can you return an explicit sample invoice line that maps the session examples to billable units?

Appreciate a concrete worked example.

Best,
Sahil
Director of AI Integrations
Atlas Retail

Attachment: Atlas_SOW_Draft_v2.pdf (application/pdf)
From: tessa_morgan@redwoodai.com

Cc: ben_carter@redwoodai.com, kimberly_park@redwoodai.com
Date: Fri, 28 Apr 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Question on bundle pricing + minimums for long-context use

Hi Sahil — thanks for the clear asks. I reviewed with Pricing and Product and put together a concise worked example below. Quick TL;DR: bundles are committed tokens that get consumed first; micro-floor (the per-call minimum) only applies to non-bundled overage or PAYG calls. KV/prefix credits reduce billable tokens in either model but are applied before bundle consumption. See the example.

Worked example (per your numbers):
- Committed bundle: 50,000 tokens/month (prepaid)
- Session A: 12,000 tokens (prompt + completion)
- Heartbeat micro-bursts across day: total 2,000 tokens
- Effective raw tokens for the user: 14,000 tokens
- KV reuse credits (example): -1,500 tokens (applied at per-request level)
- Billable tokens charged against bundle: 12,500 tokens

Notes:
- Bundles are consumed at token granularity (no per-call micro-floor applies to tokens billed from the bundle).
- Micro-floor (e.g., minimum 50 tokens per request) only triggers for PAYG overage or when a request is outside committed consumption.
- If multiple sessions reuse KV and cross-session prefix reuse is detected, the credit is applied at the request aggregation step prior to mapping to bundle vs PAYG.

I’m attaching a sample invoice line mapping and an example spreadsheet mapping sessions -> bundle consumption. Ben and Kimberly — can you confirm the phrasing and whether we can offer Atlas a one-time onboarding credit for the first-month micro-floor exposure?

Thanks — Tessa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Adding a quick pricing-side clarification to include in the reply to Sahil/procurement. Two operational caveats we should call out explicitly in the invoice and SOW: 

1) Rounding and aggregation window: we aggregate tokens per request and then apply a 1-minute session window sweep for prefix/KV aggregation. That means small micro-bursts within the same minute get grouped and billed as one logical request for micro-floor calculation if outside the bundle. For Atlas’s pattern this reduces micro-floor exposure.

2) Excess vs bundle consumption sequencing: consumption applies in the order — (a) prepaid bundle tokens, (b) prefix/KV credit reductions, (c) PAYG micro-floor/rounding if remainder exists. In practice that means prefix credits are always used to reduce consumption first, then bundle tokens are consumed.

I suggest offering a one-month waiver for micro-floor charges (cap the first month PAYG micro-floor liability to $0) and a 10% pilot discount on overage rates for the next two months. Helps close procurement.

Ben
Director, Pricing & Packaging

Sahil — following up with the final language we’ll include in the SOW and a sample invoice line (attached spreadsheet). Key points we’ll include in SOW and invoice notes: 

- Token sequencing: prefix/KV credits are calculated per-aggregation window and applied before deducting from the committed bundle.
- Bundled consumption: tokens drawn from the prepaid bundle are consumed at 1:1; no per-call micro-floor applies to tokens that are covered by the bundle.
- Micro-floor waiver: Redwood will waive micro-floor charges for the first invoice period under ATLAS-2028-Q2 and apply a 10% discounted overage rate for months 2 and 3 of the pilot.
- Invoice sample (single user session example):
  • Raw tokens: 14,000
  • KV credit applied: -1,500
  • Charged to bundle: 12,500
  • Remaining bundle balance: 37,500 (from 50,000)
  • PAYG micro-floor charges: $0 (waived for first month)

Attachments: example-invoice-sample.xlsx — mapping and line-item language included.

If that looks good I’ll push the SOW update and the purchase-order-ready invoice back to you today.

Cheers,
Tessa
